passive.name: Punishment
passive.text: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by **1.7/2/2.5/3/3.3%** every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of **10.2/12/15/18/19.8%**. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Decibel Monologue
passive.text: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.69/0.78/0.87/0.96**/s. When the equipper uses an **EX Special Attack** and deals **Physical DMG**, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by **12.5/14.3/16.1/17.9/20%** for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Exquisitely Ingenious
passive.text: When the equipper's **EX Special Attack** or **Ultimate** deals **Physical DMG**, their **Anomaly Mastery** increases by **30/34/39/43/48** for 40s. When the equipper's **Aftershock** hits an enemy, all squad members' **Anomaly Proficiency** increases by **60/69/78/87/96** for 40s. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Punishment
passive.text: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by **1.7/2/2.5/3/3.3%** every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of **10.2/12/15/18/19.8%**. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Stampede Accident
passive.text: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by **2.5/2.8/3.2/3.6/4%** for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Game Start!
passive.text: Whenever the equipper's attack triggers an Attribute Counter effect, all units' CRIT Rate against the struck enemy increases by **12/13.5/15.5/17.5/20%** for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

skillPriority: Basic Attack > Chain Attack > Special Attack > Assist > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Claws
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to 5 strikes ahead, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak
entries.text:
Hold Basic Attack to activate:
Enter a defensive stance for up to 1.5 seconds. If hit during this time, parry the attack and inflict massive Daze against the attacking enemy.
Successfully parrying an attack gains 1 **Sugar Points**.
Character is invulnerable when successfully parrying.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot
entries.text:
When Yuzuha has **Sugar Points**, landing a hit with other active characters' attacks will have Yuzuha continuously twirl her umbrella and attack centered around the target before launching a powerful shell, dealing **Physical DMG**. When this attack lands a heavy attack, Yuzuha consumes 1 **Sugar Point**.
**Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot** is considered an **Aftershock**.
**Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot** can be triggered once every 8s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rows.label: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - DMG Multiplier
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Anomaly Buildup Rate Increase
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max - DMG Multiplier
Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max - Anomaly Buildup Rate Increase

entries.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles
entries.text:
Enemies under the effect of **Sweet Scare** will be attacked by a **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** once every 1s.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** initially deals **Physical DMG**.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by **25%**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max
entries.text:
Enemies affected by **Sweet Scare** will be attacked by a **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** when hit with a heavy attack from **Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot** or **Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot**.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** initially deals **Physical DMG**.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** does not contribute its accumulated Attribute Anomaly Buildup toward Anomaly DMG calculation.
**Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by **25%**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Tanuki Helper
entries.text:
When Yuzuha is off-field, tanuki Kama assists the active character in attacking enemies, dealing **Physical DMG**.
When Yuzuha performs **Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak**, tanuki Kama joins her in attacking the enemy, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Tanuki Kama inherits Yuzuha's initial ATK.

rows.label: Tanuki Kama & Yuzuha Coordinated Attack DMG Multiplier

entries.name: Dodge: Did I Scare You?
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: You're Outta Luck!
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Rapidly strikes enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Deliver a quick strike forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Dessert Time
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Replenish Your Fun
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Upon a successful parry, gain 1 **Sugar Points**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies
entries.text:
After triggering a **Defensive Assist** or successfully parrying an enemy attack with **Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak**, press Basic Attack to activate:
Strike enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot
entries.text:
After triggering a **Defensive Assist** or successfully parrying an enemy attack with **Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak**, press Basic Attack at the right moment to activate:
Following a continuous spinning umbrella attack, fire a powerful projectile that deals **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Gummy Bombardment
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Fire a cannon shot forward, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert
entries.text:
With enough Energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Upon hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the **Sweet Scare** state.
Gains 2 **Sugar Points** upon activation.
A **Quick Assist** is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!
entries.text:
After using **Dodge Counter: Time for Payback~**, **Quick Assist: Dessert Time**, **Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies**, or **Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot**, or when a **Perfect Dodge** is triggered, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Quickly throw a bomb at the enemy, dealing **Physical DMG**.
On hitting an enemy with a heavy attack, it inflicts the **Sweet Scare** state.
Gains 2 **Sugar Points** upon activation.
A **Quick Assist** is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Sweet Scare
entries.text:
The **Sweet Scare** state lasts for **40**s, repeated triggers reset the duration.
When an enemy affected by **Sweet Scare** is first hit by an active character using an attack of their attribute, **Flavor Match** is triggered against that enemy, changing the attribute of **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** and **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** against that enemy to match that of the character who triggered Flavor Match.
When **Sweet Scare** is triggered again on an enemy, their existing **Flavor Match** state is removed. The process can be repeated to change the attribute of **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles** and **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** again.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Prank Assault
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a small area ahead, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Gains 1 **Sugar Points** when used.
A **Quick Assist** is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating reaches Maximum, press Ultimate to trigger:
Unleash a powerful strike on enemies in a large area around the character, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Enemies hit with a heavy attack are inflicted with the **Sweet Scare** state.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members gain **25** Energy.
Upon activating this skill, gain 2 **Sugar Points**.
A **Quick Assist** is triggered when this skill hits an enemy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Whimsical Wonder
entries.text:
Upon entering the battlefield, Yuzuha immediately gains 3 **Sugar Points**.
Yuzuha can have up to 6 **Sugar Points**.
When Yuzuha's **EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert**, **EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!**, or **Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief** hits an enemy, all squad members receive the **Tanuki Wish** effect.
**Tanuki Wish** grants an ATK increase equal to 40% of Yuzuha's initial ATK, up to a maximum increase of **1,200**, and increases the DMG dealt by those with the effect by 15%, lasting 40s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
If Yuzuha's initial ATK reaches 3,000, she grants the full ATK bonus to all squad members.

entries.name: Additional Ability: The More the Merrier
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Anomaly** character or shares the same Faction:
If Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery exceeds 100, every point over increases the Anomaly Buildup Rate of characters with **Tanuki Wish** by **0.2%**, up to a maximum of **20%**, and all Attribute Anomaly DMG and **Disorder** DMG by **0.2%**, up to a maximum of **20%**. When Yuzuha's Anomaly Mastery is at 200, she grants the full buff effect.

entries.name: Lucky Constitution
entries.text:
Yuzuha regains 30 Energy when she enters the battlefield. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger at most once every 180s.
Enemies in the **Sweet Scare** state have their All-Attribute RES reduced by 10%. The Attribute Anomaly DMG and **Disorder** DMG buff from her **Additional Ability** is increased to 130% of its original value.

entries.name: Full of Colorful Company
entries.text:
When Yuzuha's **EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert**, **EX Special Attack: Cavity Alert, Right Now!**, or **Ultimate: Surrender or Suffer the Mischief** hits an enemy, all squad members' DMG increases by 15% and Anomaly Buildup Rate by 15%, lasting 40s and repeated triggers reset the duration. When a heavy attack hits an enemy that is not Stunned, it will trigger a forced **Chain Attack**. **Chain Attacks** triggered this way have reduced Interrupt Level and forced **Chain Attacks** can only occur once every 20s.
Whenever another character enters through a **Chain Attack**, Yuzuha gains 1 **Sugar Points**.
Yuzuha's **Basic Attack: Hard Candy Shot** cooldown is reduced by 25%.

entries.name: Fairytale of the Haunted City
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Falling Magic
entries.text: The DMG of Yuzuha's **Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot** and **Assist Follow-Up: We Have Cookies** increases by 30%, Anomaly Buildup Rate by 20%, and triggers a **Quick Assist** when it hits an enemy.

entries.name: Dreams of a Fading Winter
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: Put Down Roots
entries.text:
Gain 1 additional **Sugar Points** when successfully parrying an enemy attack using a **Defensive Assist** or **Basic Attack: Tanuki Cloak**. When using **Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot**, hold Basic Attack to charge for up to 0.8 seconds. Releasing Basic Attack or reaching full charge fires an extra powerful shell at the enemy. For every 0.4s charged, Yuzuha consumes 1 **Sugar Point** to fire an additional powerful shell, each dealing 300% of her ATK as **Physical DMG**.
If any powerful shell from **Assist Follow-Up: Stuffed Hard Candy Shot** hits an enemy, all squad members' **Disorder** DMG Multiplier increases by 105% for 40s, and stacking up to 3 times, with each stack duration being calculated separately. In addition, if the powerful shell hits an enemy under **Sweet Scare**, it'll trigger 1 **Basic Attack: Sugarburst Sparkles - Max** attack.
If Yuzuha is attacked while charging, she will automatically dodge the attack and immediately unleash the max-charged attack.
